name: JL Keychain Tools
description: Save, retrieve, list and delete API keys / passwords in macOS Keychain. All entries are namespaced with the 'jl-' prefix so they don't mix with system entries.

options.label: How it works
options.description:
Save: select KEY=value or just the value (dialog asks for a name if no '='). Names auto-prefixed with 'jl-'.

Get: select the name → value replaces selection.

List: select any text → pick from dialog → value replaces selection.

Delete: select the name → confirms before removing.

Entries live in macOS login keychain, namespaced with 'jl-' so they don't mix with system items (Wi-Fi, Safari, etc.).

options.label: Repository & docs
options.description:
Source code, full documentation and issue tracker:

https://github.com/usblsb/popclip-keychain-tools

options.label: Extra prefixes (comma-separated)
options.description: Additional prefixes to include in List, Get and Delete (besides the always-on 'jl-'). Comma-separated, no spaces inside each prefix. Example: averiado-,mycompany-,oldproject-
